description: PySCF RHF in PySCF's own basis, CASCI active-space integrals in its MO basis, and fci.direct_spin1's lowest roots over them (conv_tol 1e-13); per case, pairs of roots (bra, ket) with their CI vectors (alpha-major), trans_rdm1(bra, ket) (gamma[p, q] = <bra| q+ p |ket>, spin summed, n x n row-major), and the symmetrized (trans_rdm12(bra, ket) + trans_rdm12(ket, bra)) / 2 as rdm1 and rdm2 (2-RDM [p, q, r, s] = <p+ r+ s q>, n^4 row-major); s2 is <S^2> of each root
